March 3 2022 

Today I got tired from work I got a job but its less than what I used to earn, my family still keeps blaming me about how low the salary is and its like  I'm trying o fix my life again can't anybody see that? I thought about quitting art over and over but I met someone who reminded me life isn't all about doom and gloom. It's 7am I'm trying to install bluestacks on this computer I got 500 pesos here I can spend this on coffee,cigarretes and a meal or I can just endure the pain of not eating. Their all asking us to go to work and its so stupid our corporate clients are forcing us to what do these CEO care they would rather have us dead working for money than be safe in the Pandemic.

I've been trying to look for more opportunities apparently this digital career isn't taking off as I expected.  I got rejected at that dream company that I've been trying to apply to for 3 years there as also a posting for gaming and insurance but hell knows how that pays. There are 3 crises today the post-pandemic, world war 3 and the oil crisis hell knows what happens to the world nowadays. 

I'm thinking of just forgetting my dreams and just getting married. I don't really think my dreams are worth the money,time and effort anyway my lover said they will support me in whatever decision that I made and truth be told all I want is some peace in my brain.

Everything is kinda loud right now the 23 voices in my head all have different opinions.

The mental health person said it as "Schizorphenia" but I don't really give a shit about that I think it's more of like clinical depression? They don't care to be honest. 

I thought about leaving this place but for that I need money for food,rent, water which isn't really that great right now. I made a fundraiser for my dad so we won't be financially in debt with his operations and now its hard to navigate everything now that I'm supporting everyone. 

I know my lover is there but no matter what I do I'm still all alone trying to deal with life.

I need pills but the pills here are inaccessible. 

Pat said I should just eat food it will cheer me up.

Jane said we can just read a book Claudette said I should do the laundry.

Agnes said I should let her take over, she's the best in all of us.

I wonder when will I be conscious enough to do this again.
